newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury up on positive broker reports.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury up on positive broker reports.

text.p: Shares in supermarket chain Sainsbury Plc rose as SBC Warburg Securities and several other houses reiterated their positive stance on the food retail sector, market sources said.
Sources said Warburg had highlighted an analysis of today's first-half figures from William Morrison Supermarkets Plc which showed profit margins had widened.
Sainsbury shares were up 8-1/2p at 376p by 1042 GMT while Tesco Plc was up three pence at 302p. Morrison dropped 1/2p to 160p after it warned sales growth would slow in the second half of this year.
Traders noted also that food retailers had had a generally poor run amid fears of a spiralling price war.
"Those worries seem to have quietened a bit and we've had several positive reports on the sector. We wouldn't call food retailers a major buy but worth holding," one marketmaker said.
